## Summary
Describe what changed and why.

## Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance
- [ ] Database schema or RLS migration

## Validation
- [ ] I tested locally
- [ ] GitHub Actions reliability tests pass
- [ ] I verified no secrets or credentials were committed
- [ ] I checked related financial calculations and member permissions (if relevant)
- [ ] I included an SQL migration and tested permissions / rollback (if database-related)

## Screenshots
Add before/after screenshots for UI changes.

## Database / deployment impact
Describe migration order, rollout risks, and rollback steps. Write "None" if not applicable.

## Reviewer notes
Explain anything the reviewer should pay particular attention to.
